world: A world where every person receives an innate power ranking at a public test; those with no ranking are treated as disposable. Academies, factions and rankings decide everything.
premise: Kang Taejin, an apparently powerless 18-year-old, gets an impossible result at the public ranking test: 'UNMEASURED'. Everyone calls him Rank Zero. At night a hidden Trial Gate appears only to him. Every trial he clears gives real power, but each upgrade takes something precious from him. His rival Ryu Hanseo, a celebrated genius, slowly becomes obsessed with him.
ending: Taejin reaches the final trial and learns why the Gate chose him; he defeats Hanseo not by hatred but by understanding, and rewrites the ranking system.

hero.face: same face every time: 18-year-old Korean-style boy, sharp eyes, messy black hair, small mole under the left eye

stages.look: thin, plain grey academy uniform, messy black hair, tired look
dark long coat over the uniform, faint white-gold glowing lines on his arms, focused eyes
tall and strong, black jacket with white-gold glowing marks across his arms and neck, calm golden eyes, a faint aura

cast_hi: कांग ताएजिन (हीरो, लड़का, जिसे सब 'रैंक ज़ीरो' कहते हैं), र्यू हानसो (घमंडी चमकता टैलेंट, मुख्य प्रतिद्वंदी), पार्क मीना (ताएजिन की सहपाठी, जो उसे समझती है), प्रोफ़ेसर ली (रैंकिंग टेस्ट के अधिकारी, जिन्हें कुछ पता है), ट्रायल गेट की आवाज़ (रहस्यमयी)
outline: At the public ranking test, Taejin's result is 'UNMEASURED'. The whole hall laughs, Ryu Hanseo mocks him, and he is branded Rank Zero and thrown out of the dorm. That night a black Trial Gate opens only for him.
Taejin enters the Gate. The first trial: survive ten minutes against shadow beasts. He learns the rule: every upgrade costs something (this time, one hour of all his senses). He barely survives.
He hides the new power. Mina notices something strange. Hanseo arranges a public duel to humiliate him.
The duel: Taejin is nearly crushed, then uses the Gate's rule in a clever way and stuns the crowd. But the crystal still shows 'UNMEASURED', which confuses everyone.
Factions circle him: one wants to recruit him, one wants to dissect him. Professor Lee secretly helps and hints that he has seen this before.
Second trial: the price this time is a precious memory (his sister's voice). Taejin gets a new power and an emotional wound.
Hanseo's family investigates Taejin, and Hanseo becomes obsessed. A faction ambush shows Taejin's new strength for the first time.
The academy tournament begins. Taejin enters under a fake low ranking to hide.
Taejin and Hanseo meet in the tournament. Taejin shows part of his power and the crowd turns on Hanseo.
The measuring crystal shatters: 'BEYOND RANK'. Cliffhanger: the Gate whispers that a third trial is open, and that someone else in the world is already on the fifth.
